definitions.explanation: The meat of horses, eaten in Japan mainly raw as {馬刺|ばさ}し. Kumamoto and Nagano are the best-known producing areas.

examples.japanese: {馬肉|ばにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{熊本|くまもと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{馬肉|ばにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Kumamoto is famous for horse meat.

examples.japanese: {馬肉|ばにく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、たんぱく⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Horse meat is said to be low in fat and high in protein.

notes:
From ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧ (horse) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat), read with the on'yomi ば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬肉|ばにく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: horse meat dishes
- {馬肉|ばにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: horse meat sashimi
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{馬肉|ばにく}: fresh horse meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{馬刺|ばさ}し→馬刺し：30436_basashi⟧: raw sliced horse meat — the usual way it is served, eaten with soy sauce, ginger, and garlic
- さくら⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: "cherry meat" — an older euphemism for horse meat, from its pink color
